augmentation.note: Synthetic variants are not new observations or independent validation. All original patterns are excluded from augmentation.

limitations: Public file matches and publisher license declarations are recorded in data/SOURCES.md; original clinical collection and patient-level provenance remain unverified.
Pattern-disjoint partitions are not independent clinical or patient-level validation.
Related symptom templates may remain across partitions.
Softmax scores are uncalibrated; no clinical accuracy or safety is established.
Missing-symptom testing is synthetic, not a clinical evaluation.
Training augmentation deletes one observed symptom from original training patterns; it adds no patient records or clinical evidence.

serving_policy_test.note: Urgent messages and abstentions are not disease predictions; these heuristics are not clinically validated.
